title: MedMix: Specialization-Consistent Federated Sparse MoEs under Modality Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2608.13911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated multimodal medical AI faces modality heterogeneity at both the client and sample levels: clients may systematically lack access to specific modality types, while individual records within the same client may contain different partial modality subsets. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are a promising remedy for modality-adaptive computation, but their use in federated learning is fragile under cross-client modality heterogeneity, where locally learned routing policies can diverge across clients and drive experts toward incompatible specializations. Different clients may assign the same observed modality configuration to different experts, or train similarly indexed experts on different missing-modality configurations, causing standard aggregation to misalign or overwrite the expert specialization that sparse MoEs are intended to learn. translated_title: MedMix：模态异质性下专业化一致性的联邦稀疏专家混合模型
translated_abstract: 联邦多模态医学人工智能面临客户端和样本层面的模态异质性：客户端可能系统性缺乏特定模态类型的访问权限，而同一客户端内的个体记录可能包含不同的部分模态子集。稀疏专家混合（MoE）架构是模态自适应计算的有前途的解决方案，但在联邦学习中使用时，在跨客户端的模态异质性下显得脆弱，因为本地学习的路由策略可能在客户端之间产生分歧，导致专家向不兼容的专业化方向发展。不同的客户端可能将相同的观测模态配置分配给不同的专家，或者在不同缺失模态配置下训练相似索引的专家，导致标准聚合错位或覆盖稀疏MoE本应学习的专家专业化。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了MedMix，一个语义对齐框架，用于...
tldr: MedMix提出了一种语义对齐框架，解决了联邦多模态医学AI中因客户端和样本级模态异质性导致的稀疏专家混合模型路由分歧和专家专业化不兼容问题。
en_tdlr: MedMix proposes a semantic-alignment framework to address routing divergence and incompatible expert specialization in federated sparse MoEs caused by client- and sample-level modality heterogeneity in multimodal medical AI.
